# postctl

> Terminal-native, Markdown-first social media scheduler (CLI + TUI) for macOS and Linux. Local SQLite data, no cloud. Free and open source for up to 2 networks; Pro (subscription, €4.90/month or €39/year) unlocks unlimited networks.

Platforms: Instagram (feed, carousel, story), Facebook pages, Threads, X, LinkedIn (profile and company page), Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord and more.

## Key facts
- Posts are Markdown files with YAML frontmatter; `postctl import` creates drafts or schedules them.
- Profiles keep accounts separate; `postctl --profile NAME daemon install` installs one scheduler service per profile.
- Safeguards: overdue posts are spread in 20-minute steps, X keeps a 60-minute minimum gap, posts are claimed atomically (never published twice).
- Remote deletion where the platform API allows it (not Instagram).
- MCP server (`postctl mcp`) lets AI assistants list, draft and schedule posts. Part of the missionctl suite.
